introHtml: Hanes tool kits combine the trusted comfort and durability of Hanes apparel with practical tools your team or customers will actually use. Whether you are outfitting new hires with a branded hoodie and multitool or handing out T-shirt and wrench sets at a company picnic, this combination keeps your logo visible long after the event. Choose from Hanes cotton tees, fleece hoodies, or sweatshirts paired with quality tools for a cohesive, useful giveaway.
